## Post

Introducing PDF Arena, the newest eval in our Office Suite alongside Slides and Spreadsheets.

Every year, people open over 400 billion PDFs and send more than 200 million PDFs through Adobe alone. PDFs are still how much of the world's work gets delivered: reports, research briefs, resumes, invoices, white papers. They're easily sharable, keep the design intact, and are still the world's preferred method of sharing documents. Making a good one, however, takes more than just writing.

In PDF Arena, two models receive a prompt from a real world user with a real use case. They research the facts, write the document as HTML and CSS, draw charts as vector graphics, and create the final PDF.
